description:
Returns a list of all timecard entries for the current date.

See [Working with Daily Logs](https://developers.procore.com/documentation/daily-logs) for information on filtering the response using the log\_date, start\_date, and end\_date parameters.

parameters.name: project_id
parameters.description: Unique identifier for the project.

parameters.name: log_date
parameters.description: Timecard entries at the specified date. (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The beginning of the date range for timecard entries. (YYYY-MM-DD) Start date is inclusive.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end of the date range for timecard entries. (YYYY-MM-DD) End date is inclusive.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Elements per page

parameters.name: serializer_view
parameters.description: Changes what fields are included in the response.

parameters.name: filters[daily_log_segment_id]
parameters.description: Daily Log Segment ID filter

parameters.name: filters[created_by_id]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) created by the specified User IDs.

parameters.name: filters[approval_status]
parameters.description: Return entries matching the specified approval status.

parameters.name: filters[billable]
parameters.description: Return entries matching billable state.

parameters.name: filters[cost_code_id]
parameters.description: Return entries matching the specified cost code ID.

parameters.name: filters[daily_log_header_id]
parameters.description: Return entries matching the specified daily log header ID.

parameters.name: filters[date]
parameters.description: Filter by date. Accepts a single date (YYYY-MM-DD) or a date range (YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return entries matching the specified entry ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[location_id]
parameters.description: Return entries matching the specified location ID.

parameters.name: filters[login_information_id]
parameters.description: Return entries matching the specified login information ID(s).

parameters.name: filters[origin_id]
parameters.description: Return entries matching the specified origin ID.

parameters.name: filters[search]
parameters.description: Text search filter for legacy search behavior.

parameters.name: filters[sub_job_id]
parameters.description: Return entries matching the specified sub job ID.

parameters.name: filters[timecard_time_type_id]
parameters.description: Return entries matching the specified timecard time type ID.

parameters.name: filters[updated_at]
parameters.description: Return entries updated within the specified datetime/date range. Formats: YYYY-MM-DD...YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ...YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.

parameters.name: filters[work_classification_id]
parameters.description: Return entries matching the specified work classification ID.

parameters.name: filters[wbs_code_id]
parameters.description: Return entries matching the specified WBS code ID.
